title: Jayo Filament: Buy 6, Get 4 Free (Add 10): 10x 1.1kg PETG White $131 ($128 eBay Plus) + Del @ Jayo-3D eBay (Excl. NT)
body:
Deal: Jayo Filament: Buy 6, Get 4 Free (Add 10): 10x 1.1kg PETG White $131 ($128 eBay Plus) + Del @ Jayo-3D eBay (Excl. NT)

[3dprintdeals] thanks, let me know if you have any feedback. Hopefully we get another round of clearance rolls.
[theSav] Dude it’s so good - not for my wallet, but oh man.
Two feedbacks:
The results seem to sort the individual items in each store from cheapest to most expensive, but don’t sort the stores themselves by cheapest to most expensive. Is that intentional?
Eg I can search for black tpu & the third store down is actually the cheapest.
(Maybe this is a stretch) Is there a way to filter out stores that do not ship to my postcode?
I love how the links it provides send you right to the product on the eBay app. Brilliant
[3dprintdeals] I'll note it down to rank the stores by cheapest.
also not healthy for our filament stockpiles
[theSav] @3dprintdeals: 3rd feedback:
It seems rolls which are not 1kg rolls report the wrong cost in the ‘per kg’ column. Perhaps this column should be a ‘per roll’
Seeing this on 0.5kg spools at least
[3dprintdeals] @theSav: noted, just doesn't work on the 5kg spools so I'll figure something out
[3dprintdeals] @3dprintdeals: also Jayo has started stocking 1kg TPU spools instead of the 500g
[rad000] I think the ability to setup email alerts could be cool
[3dprintdeals] Don't think its necessary as I'm not tracking historical pricing or stock states.
And the coupons are regular enough that you can mostly just buy when you need to.
[ScottyDont] I only needed three rolls recently and found one of the buy 6 pay 4 had a progressive discount so it ended up cheaper than a buy 3 pay 2 deal
[3dprintdeals] nice, they turn them on and off, like on the 5kg spools, if you get in early you can stack them.
[nightelves] Is the Glow in the Dark green or blue filament popular or something? Always seems to be sold out.
[3dprintdeals] they are the main glow in the dark colours and probably the brightest compared to red.
[Flippsy] Nice work! The webpage is exactly what I had in mind for doing someday but never got around to it - thanks for making everything so accessible!
[3dprintdeals] Thanks to your foundation, I still need to add the 'cheapest by type' round up you did
[2-1] I just want to take a moment to thank both of you for helping to simplify the experience for us.
[theSav] Seconded. You’ve both done wondrous work here
[Tacooo] Nice site. Reckon you can add a filter for glass-filled (PETG usually)?
[3dprintdeals] Ok, I think there's also PA6-GF with Sunlu.
